security.notes: Current security checks use least-needed workflow permissions and pinned action revisions. CodeQL scans Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Actions with security-extended queries; dependency review blocks newly introduced high-severity dependency findings; static analysis covers repository Python and JavaScript; Dependabot checks Actions, npm, and pip weekly. The latest main CodeQL run and latest pull-request dependency-review/static-analysis checks completed successfully.

local_data_safety.notes: Local data has versioned unified backup and restore, legacy backup migration, validation before restore, rollback when a restore write fails, recoverable last-known-good storage snapshots, corruption/read/write-failure reporting, and focused tests for those failure paths. Ambiguous or missing-record enrichment migration is preserved as unresolved data instead of being silently reassigned or discarded.

privacy_publication.notes: The static publication pipeline has explicit full-public, redacted, and private-local-preview profiles. Redaction runs before derived collection resources are published, removes configured sensitive per-record fields and friend-code metadata, preserves opaque stable join IDs, emits a privacy audit, and keeps browser-local user state out of the publication pipeline. The deployment guard blocks private-local-preview from Pages promotion, with focused tests covering redaction and deployment blocking.

external_data.notes: Production external inputs require reviewed source/license registry ownership, explicit authority and redistribution metadata, stable join validation, bounded freshness policies, and source-attributed timestamps. Consumers receive stale/expired/unavailable states instead of silently treating old data as current. Malformed refreshes preserve committed last-known-good data when available, source scraping remains disabled, and the core collection remains usable with no external provider or paid runtime service.

pokemon_go_mechanics.notes: The mechanics registry records supported, partial, and unsupported coverage explicitly. Current watched official sources were manually reviewed through #288. #292 removed changing Help Center age labels from source fingerprints, #293 recorded a stable reviewed v3 baseline, and #294 repaired stale tests so the current detector and baseline are verified together. The bounded weekly/manual detector reports future watched-page changes for review. Incomplete Rocket battle inputs remain explicitly tracked by #144 instead of being treated as verified mechanics.

machine_outputs.notes: Generated machine resources are validated against deterministic schema and cross-file contracts before promotion.
